study type: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Cervical length (CL) measurement (< 10 mm vs >= 10 mm)
Timing of CL measurement (at hospital discharge, 2, 4, 8, and 12 weeks post-discharge)
outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth prior to 37 weeks' gestation
cohort: The study participants were 226 women discharged from hospital after their first episode of threatened preterm labor who remained undelivered.
finding: Women with a cervical length less than 10 mm at hospital discharge or at any follow-up visit up to 4 weeks later had a significantly higher risk of spontaneous preterm birth prior to 37 weeks' gestation.
followup_time: Up to 12 weeks post-discharge for cervical length measurements, with outcome assessed until spontaneous delivery prior to 37 weeks' gestation.
gest_age: Outcome defined as spontaneous delivery prior to 37 weeks' gestation.
